summary_text: 1 of 3 sequences has codons that do not match their amino acid (kept in the alignment).
methods_text: Codon alignments were built with COAL v0.5.0 (https://github.com/plumat-coal/COAL), which places each coding DNA sequence onto the protein multiple sequence alignment codon by codon (the method of PAL2NAL; Suyama et al. 2006), using the standard genetic code (NCBI translation table 1). Of 3 sequences, 2 matched their protein exactly, and 1 contained codons that did not match the aligned amino acid (kept in the alignment). Command: coal pep.aln nuc.fasta -output codon -o out.codon
